test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A hollow ball is to be made with outer radius 7 units and inner radius 3.5 units. How much material (in cubic units) will be required to make the ball (take pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
**Given:**

Outer radius (R) = 7 units

Inner radius (r) = 3.5 units

pi = (22)/(7)

**Formula used:**

Volume of hollow sphere = (4)/(3)pi (R³ - r³)

**Calculation:**

Volume = (4)/(3)pi (R³ - r³)

⇒ Volume = (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times (7³ - 3.5³)

⇒ Volume = (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times (343 - 42.875)

⇒ Volume = (4)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 300.125

⇒ Volume = (4 times 22 times 300.125)/(3 times 7)

⇒ Volume = (3773)/(3)

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
